Upstream: sqlx-sqlite 0.8.6, https://github.com/launchbadge/sqlx
Source: verified crates.io package sqlx-sqlite-0.8.6
Reason: CVE-2026-119375 / RUSTSEC-2026-0459 requires libsqlite3-sys >=0.39.0.
Released SQLx 0.8.6 requires 0.30.1; even SQLx 0.9.0 caps it below 0.38.
Local change: update the libsqlite3-sys constraint to 0.39.1 in both manifests.
Driver source and upstream MIT/Apache licenses are preserved.
Remove this patch when a compatible upstream SQLx release supports patched SQLite.
